name: va
description:
To all those who stumble upon this arbitrary server in the infinite mass of Minecraft servers:

Birch's World will be reset many times during its lifetime, as it is a mirrored backup of an offline world, thus all buildings built will be lost on an unregulated schedule.

Birch's World is a safe haven for all who know its purpose.

Birch's World is free to all who belong.

Birch's World will protect you once you join, but know that once you join, you cannot unjoin.

Birch's World is just and will punish injustice as such.

Birch's World will serve its purpose and demand nothing in return.

All we ask of you is to love the LORD with all your heart, soul, mind; and to love your neighbor as yourself. Matthew 22:34–40

To permanently win easier and faster: Act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our Lord. (Micah 6:8)

Matthew 5:3-12

https://www.bible.com/bible/59/MAT.5.3-12

' “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. those who mourn, for they shall be comforted. “Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth. “Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be satisfied. the merciful, for they shall receive mercy. the pure in heart, for they shall see God. the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God. “Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for “Blessed are you when others revile you and persecute you and utter all kinds of evil against you falsely on my account. Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven, for so they persecuted the prophets who were before you.'

Yes this is a Christian Minecraft Server if you haven't picked it up already
